session_unavailable: WARNING: persistent session unavailable ({error}); using a one-off login.
local_backup_incomplete: Local host backup empty/incomplete; aborting for safety
method_no_config: access {method} does not collect config; register SSH
backup_too_short: backup empty/too short; aborting for safety
change_description: Automatic backup before/after a change session on a host (begin/end/check).
help_mode: Proxmox CT/VM only: pre-change snapshot or no backup
help_tag: CT/VM: short label in the snapshot name
help_force_space: CT/VM: ignore the pool space block
missing_backup: BACKUP MISSING: run `python3 scripts/tools/backup/change.py begin --host-id {host_id}` before changing host {host_id}.
skip_disabled: SKIP: host {host_id} has backup_before_change off (use --force to force it)
ask_snapshot: ASK THE USER: host {host_id} is {kind} {vmid} on Proxmox (host {pve_id}). Take a snapshot before the change? Yes → `change.py begin --host-id {host_id} --mode snapshot [--tag x]`; No → `... --mode none`.
no_backup_declined: OK: no backup (the user declined the snapshot)
end_snapshot_kept: OK: change finished. Snapshot {snapshot} is still on Proxmox.
ask_delete_snapshot: ACTION: tell the user you are done and ASK (AskUserQuestion) whether to delete the snapshot: `python3 scripts/tools/backup/snapshot.py delete --host-id {host_id}` (only after a 'yes').
guest_not_found:
{tool} {vmid} does not exist on this Proxmox:
{output}
not_guest_detail: host {host_id} is not a Proxmox CT/VM (needs runs_on + 'CT N' in the notes or vmid:)
no_managed_disk: no managed disk found in the config of {tool} {vmid}
storage_no_snapshot: storage '{store}' ({type}) does not support {kind} snapshots. Alternative: vzdump (stop/snapshot mode) or config backup (change.py begin --mode config).
pool_blocked: BLOCKED: pool '{store}' has no headroom ({reasons}; limit {limit}%). Nothing was created. Free up space or, if the user accepts the risk, repeat with --force-space.
snapshot_missing:
snapshot did NOT appear in the list; aborting the change:
{output}
stale_snapshots: WARNING: old netops-pre- snapshots already existed on this guest: {names}; offer to delete them.
no_pending_host: no pending snapshot for this host (pass --name)
refuse_delete: refusing to delete '{name}': only {prefix}* snapshots created by NetOps
snapshot_description: Pre-change snapshot of a Proxmox CT/VM (create/list/delete/pending).
